def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys onto the defaults mode=fast and level=3.

    keys[i] is set to values[i]. Returns the resulting values in the order
    mode, level, then the other keys in the order they first appear. When a
    key repeats, the last value wins.
    """
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(["mode"], ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
    ex settings(["level", "color"], ["5", "red"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
    ex settings(["mode", "mode"], ["a", "b"]) == ["b", "3"]
    d: dict[str, str] = {"mode": "fast", "level": "3"}
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        d[keys[i]] = values[i]
    out: list[str] = []
    for v in d.values():
        out.append(v.copy())
    return out
